evidence_summary: Cataloged 292 first-party paths and inspected 254 text/source/config/schema/test/content files.

Next.js ^15.5.18, React ^18.3.1, Prisma ^5.22.0, NextAuth ^5.0.0-beta.25; scripts: dev, build, start, lint, typecheck, test, db:migrate, db:push, db:seed, db:reset-signals, db:studio, db:reset, postinstall.
Security headers include nosniff, DENY frame options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy; images allow SVG with CSP.

Enums: Role, OrderStatus, PaymentStatus, PaymentMethod, SellerStatus, ReviewStatus, CouponType, ReturnStatus, NotificationType. Models include User, Account, Session, VerificationToken, PasswordResetToken, Address, Seller, Category, Brand, Product, ProductView, ProductImage, ProductVariant, VariantOption, ProductAttribute, ProductSpec, FlashSale, FlashSaleItem, Cart, CartItem, Wishlist, WishlistItem, CompareItem, RecentlyViewed, Order, OrderItem, OrderStatusHistory, Payment, ReturnRequest, Review, Coupon, Banner, HomepageSection, ShippingZone, ShippingSettings, Notification, Setting, AuditLog, ContactMessage, NewsletterSubscriber.
NextAuth uses PrismaAdapter, Google, Credentials, bcrypt, and blocks inactive users.
Middleware checks auth cookie prefixes for /admin and /account; it does not decode session role.
Admin layout checks auth() and ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN before rendering.
Shared requireAdminSession enforces ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN for admin APIs.
Rate limiter is an in-memory Map keyed by x-forwarded-for/x-real-ip/unknown.

Env variable names present: DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, UPLOADTHING_SECRET, UPLOADTHING_APP_ID, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, BKASH_APP_KEY, BKASH_APP_SECRET, BKASH_USERNAME, BKASH_PASSWORD, BKASH_IS_SANDBOX, NAGAD_MERCHANT_ID, NAGAD_PG_PUBLIC_KEY, NAGAD_MERCHANT_PRIVATE_KEY, NAGAD_IS_SANDBOX, EMAIL_SERVER_HOST, EMAIL_SERVER_PORT, EMAIL_SERVER_USER, EMAIL_SERVER_PASSWORD, EMAIL_FROM, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_NAME. Values were masked and not copied.
.env is ignored and git ls-files .env returned no tracked path.
Product/category/page metadata helpers build canonical, Open Graph, Twitter, robots, and Bangladesh price-intent copy.
Dynamic sitemap includes static pages and active product/category URLs.
robots allows public crawl and disallows admin/api/account/checkout/auth/cart.
JSON-LD generators cover Product, Offer, shipping, returns, ratings/reviews, BreadcrumbList, Organization, WebSite/SearchAction, OnlineStore, FAQ, ItemList.
Home page emits Organization/WebSite/LocalBusiness JSON-LD and uses ISR revalidate=300.
Product page uses cached DB fetches, revalidate=60, product metadata, Product/Breadcrumb JSON-LD, approved reviews, and related products.
Category page has metadata, filters, pagination, JSON-LD; effective-price sort fetches all matches before slicing.
Search page generates simple title/description; effective-price sort fetches all matches before slicing.
Order API requires auth, rate limits, validates active payment method, ignores client prices, validates stock/coupons, and creates order/payment in a transaction.
Checkout redirects unauthenticated users and gates payment options by PAYMENT_GATEWAYS availability.
COD is available; bKash/Nagad are gated by NEXT_PUBLIC_BANGLADESH_ONLINE_PAYMENTS; Stripe unavailable.
Order confirmation fetches by orderNumber without auth() and renders name, phone, address, items, totals, payment status.
Account order detail requires auth and scopes lookup to id plus session.user.id.
Review API requires sign-in, delivered order, and no duplicate product/user review.
Return API requires owner, delivered status, no existing return, and 7-day window.
Admin product editor assigns products to the approved first-party seller returned by getOfficialSeller.
Uploads accept data:image/*, infer extension from MIME, process with Sharp, and store under public uploads; no explicit decoded byte/pixel cap or strict MIME allowlist found.
User admin route prevents non-super-admins from managing SUPER_ADMIN and prevents self-deactivation/self-demotion.
Admin audit log write failures are swallowed silently.
Admin report CSV escapes commas/quotes/newlines and formula-prefix values.
README references seller routes/foundation, but route scan found 0 seller/vendor route files.
TypeScript typecheck passed.
Lint passed; Next warned next lint is deprecated and removed in Next.js 16.
Tests passed: 85 tests, 20 suites, 0 failures.
Skipped because next build writes .next outside audit-reports under audit-only rules.
No AGENTS.md found.
Worktree already had modified public category image assets; audit did not modify them.
TypeScript strict is enabled; allowJs, skipLibCheck, and incremental are also enabled.
README lists Framer Motion, TanStack Query, SWR, Embla Carousel but package.json does not include them.
Seed script prints demo credentials; it was not run.
Database module has temporary any-typed Prisma delegate shim.
Static scan found console statements, any usage, and broad catch blocks in source/scripts/tests.
Payment webhook env variables exist, but no /api/*webhook* route was found.
Tests focus on validators/utilities; no browser/e2e flow tests found.
No Playwright/Lighthouse/browser checks were run.
Live payment, tracking, email, SMS, production DB services were not called.
Dependency advisory audit was skipped; no local audit script and registry access not required.
Public contact/newsletter APIs validate fields and rate limit.
Admin order status route enforces transition table, re-stocks cancellation, notifies buyer, logs audit.
Admin payment status route updates/creates Payment rows; no gateway verification in this route.
Schema has order/payment/shipping basics but no explicit shipment event, invoice, fraud, payout, or webhook event models.
Product view tracking uses user or guest viewer key.
Store layout wraps customer pages with Header, Footer, Providers, CartDrawer.
Flows inspected in source/tests but not clicked in browser.
CDN, production runtime, hosted secret store, and deployment settings not verified.
Sitemap catches DB errors and falls back to static pages.
Coupon validation route exists alongside final order-server validation.
Cart/wishlist/compare are client-side Zustand stores; server merge not verified.
